mentions.name: SMS text-only assistant
mentions.description: An SMS-based, text-only interface that lets users search for library books, find the next train, and serve up the current week's NFL schedule. Started as a project to gain comfort with local LLMs and function calling, with SMS messaging handled through a cheap Android phone using TextBee.dev.
mentions.problem: Originally built to gain comfort with local LLMs and function calling; currently Ollama runs too slowly on a Macbook Air M2.
